I recently stayed at Vertu Hotel in Mahipalpur, and my experience was genuinely pleasant. The hotel is located very close to the airport, which makes it extremely convenient for early flights or transit stays.

Rooms:
The rooms were clean, comfortable, and better maintained compared to many nearby properties. The interiors felt modern, tidy, and well-organised. The bed was comfortable, and overall room quality was impressive for the price.

Cleanliness:
This was one of the biggest positives. The room, washroom, and linens were all neat and fresh. The hotel clearly pays attention to cleanliness, which made the stay comfortable.

Service:
The staff were polite, quick to assist, and always helpful — from check-in to room service. They responded promptly when needed and made the stay smooth.

Food:
The in-room dining was decent and served on time. Breakfast options were simple but good enough for a short stay.

Location:
Excellent connectivity — the hotel is in the same premises as several other hotels like Viva Palace, but Vertu stands out with better upkeep and overall experience.

The room was spacious, but unfortunately our experience was not comfortable. The fan was making a lot of noise, so we decided to switch on the AC, but it was not working. Because of this, we couldn’t sleep the whole night. There were also many mosquitoes in the room. We informed the staff, and they provided us with mosquito repellent, which we appreciate.

Additionally, the breakfast buffet was just for the name. There were very limited options and not much variety. Overall, the stay was disappointing and not worth the experience.
